direct_evidence.body:
## 2026-09-04

Cerre la validacion pendiente desde el 24 ago. Composer confirmo que Item Discount Description es un campo calculado unico, sin ambiguedad entre type, code o reason. SQL contra EnumerationReferenceData del cliente 46 confirmo que itemdiscounttype ya existe ahi con keys employee, free, loyalty, manual_price y other. Rutee a Engineering, no Delivery. Pegue el internal note con las dos conclusiones, la definicion desactualizada y el TYPE other que no coincide con Loyalty Discount, y transicione a Under Engineering Review, quedo Shandana Khan. Pegue tambien el update a Becky por cadencia semanal vencida. Pendiente bajar los tres adjuntos de Becky a adjuntos/RCS-28327/. (19:54)

direct_evidence.body:
## 2026-08-24

Cargue contexto y traje la nota interna de Edwin del 20 ago. Causa raiz propuesta: falta el workbook de enumeraciones CRDM 2.0 para el cliente 46, la columna Item Discount Description sale en blanco. Escribi el plan de validacion en inbox/2026-08-24-rcs-28327-validacion-composer.md: confirmar el field ID en Composer, reproducir el 0 filas en secure.Repo, comparar contra otro cliente, y separar hueco de contenido de definicion muerta post V3. Sin borradores hasta cerrar eso. (17:41)

direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-04-rcs-28327-comentario-interno
direct_evidence.body:
Scope. Edwin states this is not isolated to loyalty discounts or to one store. It affects every item discount on this client where the type field renders through this same lookup.

Troubleshooting performed. Edwin Garzon queried ARDM_ITEMDISCOUNT and secure.Repo directly against production, read only, on August 20. I confirmed the EnumerationReferenceData content and the Composer field structure today, also read only. AI assisted in interpreting the EnumerationReferenceData output and the Composer field structure, cross referencing them against Edwin's August 20 findings, before this comment was drafted. No conversation with Engineering happened outside this ticket before this comment.

What I need. Update the Item Discount Description definition to resolve against EnumerationReferenceData instead of the CRDM 2.0 xlsx path for client 46. Confirm whether the same stale definition exists on other clients migrated from V2 to V3. Confirm whether TYPE should be loyalty instead of other for AdvancedFrequentShopper and FrequentShopper events in the client 46 parser.
direct_evidence.source_kind: borrador o nota local, envío no verificado

direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-04-rcs-28327-comentario-interno
direct_evidence.body:
Conclusion, second point. Redirecting the definition to EnumerationReferenceData does not close this ticket by itself. TYPE for this transaction is other, and other maps to OTHER in EnumerationReferenceData, not to Loyalty Discount. The legacy 3.5 receipt for the same transaction prints Reason: Loyalty Discount. Confirm whether AdvancedFrequentShopper and FrequentShopper POS events should set TYPE to loyalty instead of other in the parser. Without that second fix the column stops being blank and shows OTHER, which does not match what the customer saw before the upgrade.

Precedent. RCS-27761, same client 46, same reporter, Tender Check Amount blank on Payroll Check tender. Nikita Rathore found MediaNo 4 was missing because it originally mapped to paper Food Stamps. Engineering fixed it with a PR adding MediaNo 4. Same symptom family, an enumeration value missing at the platform level, resolved by Engineering.

direct_evidence.body:
La decisión es entre escalar ya con lo que hay o cerrar primero la validación de Edwin. El instructivo abajo resuelve la falsa disyuntiva. Los dos pasos de validación que quedaron pendientes desde el 24 de agosto, paso A en Composer y paso D contra EnumerationReferenceData, se ejecutan en minutos y no requieren esperar a nadie más. Con ese resultado el comentario interno se pega ya, sin transición a ciegas y sin repetir el riesgo de que Peyman devuelva el ticket si el ruteo se decide antes de tener el dato.

Aparte de la escalación técnica, la actualización a Becky no depende de este resultado y está vencida por cadencia. Va en el instructivo como paso independiente.
